author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices walking and running rhythms, skips and steps, a verse and chorus that share one tune, and left-hand low notes, using a campfire song.

classes.title: Three in a row, then hop
classes.goal: Find the hand position on C and learn the first half, where notes come in threes.

mathTarget.parentLine: Three Cs, then the same idea on three Es

classes.parentPrompt: Thumb on C. You play the low G below the thumb; your child plays the rest.
classes.childAction: Play C, C, C, then E, E, E, C. Grown-up plays low G.
classes.bridge: In a cav-ern: three on C; in a can-yon: three on E, higher.

intro.caption: Thumb on C, hand on five keys
intro.parentCue: you play the low G below the thumb

games.caption: In a cavern: C, C, C
games.parentCue: You play the low G right after

games.caption: In a canyon: E, E, E, C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a pattern that repeats one step higher.

classes.title: Skip up, walk down
classes.goal: Learn the next lines: skip up C, E, G, then walk down step by step.

mathTarget.parentLine: Jumping up over keys, then walking down one key at a time

classes.parentPrompt: Hop your fingers up your child's arm for the skips, then walk them down.
classes.childAction: Skip up with 1, 3, 5, then walk down 4, 3, 2.
classes.bridge: Excavating: skip up the canyon wall, then climb down step by step.

intro.caption: Skip up, walk down
intro.parentCue: hop up their arm, then walk down

games.caption: Excavating for a mine
games.parentCue: Say one, three, five, five, four, three, two

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing skips going up and steps going down.

classes.title: Same tune, new words
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and discover the verse and chorus share one tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: The story part and the chorus use the same notes

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the verse, then the chorus, and ask: 'Did the notes change, or only the words?'
classes.childAction: Play the tune twice: once for the verse, once for 'Oh my darling'.
classes.bridge: One tune wears two coats: story words, then 'Oh my darling' words.

intro.caption: Did the notes change?
intro.parentCue: ask after the chorus; let your child decide

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: noticing a verse and chorus with one tune.

classes.title: Run-ning, run-ning, walk
classes.goal: Practise the start slowly: two running notes fit in the time of one walking note.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two quick running notes take as long as one walking note

classes.parentPrompt: Clap two quick claps for 'run-ning' and one slow clap for 'walk' before your child plays.
classes.childAction: Clap, then play: run-ning walk, on C then on E.
classes.bridge: In a: two quick running steps; cav-ern: walking steps on the canyon path.

games.caption: Run-ning walk, slowly
games.parentCue: Say run-ning, walk with the notes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two short notes in the time of one long.

classes.title: The left hand lives low
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar while the grown-up plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: The left side of the piano holds the low notes

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child find low C on the left; count 'one, two, three' and nod on 'one'.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays low C on each 'one', then waits.
classes.bridge: The left hand is the miner deep in the cavern: low and steady.

intro.caption: Down into the cavern
intro.parentCue: help find low C, far left

games.caption: Low C, low G, low C
games.parentCue: Count one, two, three for each note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding low notes with the left hand.

classes.title: Keep the lantern swinging
classes.goal: Keep the left-hand low notes going at full speed while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: A low note that comes back once every bar

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune; sway together on each 'one' so your child feels where the low note goes.
classes.childAction: Keep your low notes going, even if one goes missing.
classes.bridge: The low note swings like a miner's lantern: once each bar, steady.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping a steady low note at full speed.

classes.title: Two hands, one campfire
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left-hand note on each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: The left hand plays once while the right hand counts three

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three' very slowly and tap your child's left hand on 'one'.
classes.childAction: Left hand on 'one', right hand plays the tune.
classes.bridge: Left hand is the log, right hand is the flame: both make the fire.

intro.caption: Two hands, one campfire
intro.parentCue: tap their left hand on every one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands with different jobs, slowly.

classes.title: A bit faster now
classes.goal: Play both hands together closer to full speed, keeping the same pattern.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same notes and order, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: If notes fall apart, smile and say 'slow again'; speed comes last.
classes.childAction: Play both hands a little faster; slow down if it tangles.
classes.bridge: The same campfire song, now walking a little quicker.

intro.caption: Same song, a bit quicker
intro.parentCue: go back to slow if it tangles

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same pattern at a faster speed.

classes.title: Campfire play-along
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going to the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping pace with the music, all the way to the end

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the chorus beside your child and sway on each 'one'; if they slip, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music; keep going after a slip.
classes.bridge: Everyone round the campfire sings at the same pace.

intro.caption: Sing round the campfire
intro.parentCue: sing beside your child and keep going

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping pace with the music to the end.

classes.title: Campfire concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy: the grown-up sings the verse, everyone joins the chorus.

mathTarget.parentLine: One voice tells the story, then everyone joins in

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; sing the verse alone, then sing the chorus together and bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy and sing loudly on 'Oh my darling'.
classes.bridge: The verse is one storyteller; the chorus is the whole campfire singing.

intro.caption: A campfire song for teddy
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song together, verse and chorus.
